info.name: API Reference Accounting Codes Electronic Payments Health API

params.name: paymentGatewayType
params.description: Filters the volume summary by payment gateway type. Example: `Adyen`.

params.name: paymentMethodType
params.description: Filters the volume summary by payment method type. Example: `CreditCard`.

params.name: startTime
params.description:
Start time of the volume summary.

Format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mmZ` Example: `2022-09-22T09:07+0800`.

params.name: endTime
params.description:
End time of the volume summary.

Format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mmZ` Example: `2022-09-22T09:07+0800`.

items.docs:
Returns a summary of electronic payments handled by your Zuora tenant within a specified time range.

You can filter the summary by payment gateway type and payment method type.
